steps.title: The Opening Question
steps.content:
So {{contact_first_name}}, how has your digestion been since you finished the gut health program with us? I usually hear one of three things. Still doing well, a little starting to creep back, or pretty much back to how it was. Which one is closest for you?

(Only three answers. Tap the one you hear.)

steps.title: Doing Great
steps.content:
That's great to hear, {{contact_first_name}}. That's exactly what we hope for when someone finishes a program with us. {{provider_name}} will be glad to know you're still doing well.

(Let them respond, then continue.)

steps.title: Starting to Creep Back
steps.content:
That happens, {{contact_first_name}}. Gut issues can be stubborn, and once the program ends the gut can slip back into old patterns. That's the reason we call. Your notes say you were feeling much better when you finished. What do you think brought it back?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Pretty Much Back to Before
steps.content:
That happens, {{contact_first_name}}. Gut issues can be stubborn, and once the program ends the gut can slip back into old patterns. That's the reason we call. Your notes say you were feeling much better when you finished. What do you think brought it back?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Ask Permission for the Questions
steps.content:
While I have you, {{contact_first_name}}, can I ask you a few quick questions about anything else you've noticed?

(Wait for the yes. It's their file, so almost everyone says yes.)

steps.title: The Transition: Ask Permission
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, you said {{complaint_reference}} has been coming back. We'll come back to that. First, can I ask you a few quick questions so your file is up to date?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: The Questions: Update the File
steps.content:
(Write down every symptom they mention. You'll recap them in a moment.)

First, any bloating or that overly full feeling?

How about your energy, any crashes in the afternoon?

Any heartburn or reflux, even the kind you handle with an antacid?

How regular are things, has anything changed?

Is your list of foods you avoid getting longer?

Any brain fog?

How about your mood, any more stress than usual?

Any headaches, even mild ones that go away on their own?

And are you taking any medications or supplements, even over the counter?

(Recap what you wrote down, then ask:)

{{contact_first_name}}, of those, which one bothers you the most?

(If they named nothing, skip the pick and use the "nothing" button.)

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: The Questions: Update the File
steps.content:
(They already said the old symptoms are coming back. Write down every symptom they mention, including that.)

First, any bloating or that overly full feeling?

How about your energy, any crashes in the afternoon?

Any heartburn or reflux, even the kind you handle with an antacid?

How regular are things, has anything changed?

Is your list of foods you avoid getting longer?

Any brain fog?

How about your mood, any more stress than usual?

Any headaches, even mild ones that go away on their own?

And are you taking any medications or supplements, even over the counter?

(Recap everything, including what's coming back, then ask:)

{{contact_first_name}}, between what's coming back and these, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Making It Real
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'd like to ask a few quick questions about {{main_concern}} so your file is up to date. It'll only take a minute.

(Ask these three questions in order. Write down the answers. Pause after each.)

How long has it been bothering you, like a month or two, or longer than that?

(Let them answer.)

Is it something you notice like a few days a month, or is it most days?

(Let them answer.)

When it's at its worst, does it ever interfere with work, at home, or relaxing and doing your own thing?

(Let them answer. Repeat back whatever they name.)

Thank you for sharing that. It makes sense, and it's something we help people with all the time.

steps.title: The Recommendation
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, that's worth getting looked at instead of just dealing with it. Can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in so {{provider_name}} can take a look at {{main_concern}}. If we can help, we'll walk you through the options. If it's not the right fit, we'll say so. Either way you'll know where you stand. Does that sound reasonable?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: They Hesitate: Find Out Why
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, you said {{main_concern}} has been getting to you. I don't want to assume anything. Is it the timing, or is something else holding you back from getting it looked at?

(Stay curious, not pushy. Do not argue. Let them give you the real reason.)

steps.title: Nothing Found: Why Did They Stop?
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'm glad you're doing so well.

Can I ask what changed that led you to stop coming in for your check-ins?

(Let them answer. Listen all the way through. Do not argue with it.)

(Tap the button below that is closest to their reason.)

steps.title: Objection: “It came back when I went back to my old eating”
steps.content:
I understand. The gut can be stubborn, and once you're off the program it can slip back into old patterns. That's why coming in makes sense. We look at the whole picture and make a plan to keep it settled.

Can we get you in so we can take a look?

steps.title: Objection: “I’m embarrassed I let it slip back”
steps.content:
Please don't be. This happens to almost everyone who stops. That's the reason we call. We'd just like to help you get back to where you were.

Would you be open to that?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: Objection: Bad experience or it didn’t fully work
steps.content:
(Never give medical advice on the call.)

I understand, {{contact_first_name}}, and I'm glad you told me. That's the kind of thing {{provider_name}} would want to talk through with you in person.

Is there anything else on your mind?

steps.title: If They Say: “I was feeling fine”
steps.content:
That makes sense, {{contact_first_name}}, and that's the best reason there is. When you feel good, coming in stops feeling urgent. Feeling this good is the result of the work you did. The check-ins are what keep it that way.

Does that make sense?

(Let them answer.)

Was there anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they raise another reason, go back and tap the button for it. If that was it, continue.)

{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

My recommendation is that we get you back on the schedule so you keep feeling this good. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: Cost or Insurance
steps.content:
I understand, {{contact_first_name}}, and I'm glad you told me. Check-in visits are spaced out and cost a fraction of fixing a problem that's been sliding for months. And you're not committing to anything. It's one visit to make sure everything is staying on track.

Does that seem fair?

(Let them answer.)

(Do not quote prices, packages, or discounts. The office handles that.)

Was there anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they raise another reason, go back and tap the button for it. If that was it, continue.)

{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

My recommendation is that we get you back on the schedule. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: “Life got busy”
steps.content:
I hear you, {{contact_first_name}}. Life fills up fast, and this kind of thing gets pushed down the list. It happens to everyone. A check-in visit is quick, and we can find a time that works around your schedule.

Would that work?

(Let them answer.)

Was there anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they raise another reason, go back and tap the button for it. If that was it, continue.)

{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

My recommendation is that we get you back on the schedule at a time that's easy for you. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: “I’ll come back if it comes back”
steps.content:
That's a fair way to think about it, {{contact_first_name}}. The one thing I'd share is that with the gut, symptoms are usually the last thing to show up. By the time the flare-ups are back, things have been drifting for a while. Catching it at a check-in usually means a small adjustment instead of starting over.

Does that sound right?

(Let them answer.)

Was there anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they raise another reason, go back and tap the button for it. If that was it, continue.)

{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

My recommendation is that we get you back on the schedule so we catch it early. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: If They Say: They Moved or Tried Another Provider
steps.content:
That's understandable, {{contact_first_name}}. Things change. If you're still in the area, we'd love to see you again. Your whole history is in your file, so we can pick up right where you left off.

Would that be okay?

(Let them answer.)

Was there anything else holding you back, or was that pretty much it?

(If they raise another reason, go back and tap the button for it. If that was it, continue.)

{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

My recommendation is that we get you back on the schedule. Does that sound reasonable?

steps.title: The Transition: Ask Permission
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, you said {{complaint_reference}} is pretty much back to where it was. We'll come back to that. First, can I ask you a few quick questions so your file is up to date?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: The Questions: Update the File
steps.content:
(They already said the old symptoms are back. Write down every symptom they mention, including that.)

First, any bloating or that overly full feeling?

How about your energy, any crashes in the afternoon?

Any heartburn or reflux, even the kind you handle with an antacid?

How regular are things, has anything changed?

Is your list of foods you avoid getting longer?

Any brain fog?

How about your mood, any more stress than usual?

Any headaches, even mild ones that go away on their own?

And are you taking any medications or supplements, even over the counter?

(Recap everything, including what's come back, then ask:)

{{contact_first_name}}, between what's come back and these, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Objection: “I need to think about it”
steps.content:
That's fair, {{contact_first_name}}. Can I ask what part you'd want to think over? Sometimes it's the cost, sometimes the timing, and sometimes people want to be sure it's worth coming in.

(Listen. Their answer usually points to one of the buttons below. If it stays general, keep going.)

Coming in is really just information. We take a look at {{main_concern}}, and you decide with real answers. If we can't help, we'll tell you that too.

Does that help?

steps.title: Objection: “Just send me some info”
steps.content:
I'd be glad to send you some information, {{contact_first_name}}. The one thing I'd say is that a flyer can only tell you so much. It can't look at what's going on with {{main_concern}} for you. That's what the visit is for. So let me get you on the schedule first, and then I'll send the information along.

Does that work for you?
